changes: The opt-in CLI hashes actual bounded regular-file bytes instead of accepting a declared input hash.
Input and snapshot files are opened read-only with O_NOFOLLOW when available and verified through fstat.
Snapshot JSON rejects duplicate keys and is validated before the shared K1 manifest writer runs.
The CLI defaults repository, branch, run and head identity from GitHub runtime environment variables but starts no workflow.

resolved_test_failure.cause: The initial test literal contained the wrong expected SHA256 for the fixed byte string.
resolved_test_failure.resolution: The literal was corrected to the independently observed hashlib value; focused and full suites then passed.
